name: teal_tubes
description: glossy teal tubes spiralling over brushed bronze, small teal spiral copies feathered along every arm
reuses: light (slope relief on the smooth count, molten_flow)
notes: Discarded (item 038): round one kept nothing, so its map teal_tubes left the library (only picked palettes are saved); it suggests the library map nearest that one by M1 when it was admitted.
Added: nothing new to the engine; the map teal_tubes (umber and bronze for the ground, teal to sea green near the set), no far-field multiply, so the ground stays bronze.

Lessons: item 036 brought six references whose look is glossy lit tubes or blades sweeping along a spiral's arms with the set's filigree all round them (dessert-union, evening-radiance, eventide, exile, fools-paradise, deadly-nightshade, all -25.jpg), and they went in as **one stack in six palettes**: molten_flow's glossy relief (a light on the smooth count at one band, no ring), a strip trap's blades lit edge to edge as cylinders (shaded_blades), and falloff glows on `de` laid last. **One strip, not a lattice**: a lattice of strips is a target every orbit hits, so its blades fan over the whole frame as shards and arcs; one strip (radius 0.3 through 0.5, no `spacing`) is missed by most orbits, and its entries string along the arms as a staircase of petals. **Bound both ends and fade towards the set**: unbounded at 0.15 of the frame the blades read as a gloss sheet that swallows the lace, leaving only its hair; at `largest` 0.08 and `smallest` 0.015, masked by the inverted smooth count to power 3, they sit in the far field between the spiral copies and the filigree stays on top. A magnified view (zoom 0.3) of the same count as rimmed sheets gives a ghost of bigger arms beneath, the references' blurred copies, but a light cannot read a view, so the ghost is never lit (the `ghost` formulation). Seats are a `--spiral` scout (seed 36) over final139_general and final140_general2000; dense lace seats read the blades as hatching and were dropped, and the phoenix-classic spirals, whose big arms are a clear staircase, read best. Round one is drawn at --draft (about 1 s a frame at six threads).
